items.headline: Ethereum Foundation Unveils zkAPI for Private Payments
items.summary: The Ethereum Foundation introduced zkAPI, a prepaid tool for private API payments that separates billing from requests. A new privacy use case for the $ETH ecosystem.

items.headline: Solana Ships Native Payments Rail for Subscriptions
items.summary: Solana launched a built-in payments rail supporting recurring subscriptions and allowances, expanding real-world payment utility for $SOL.

items.headline: Tokenized Stocks Hit 4.3M Holders, $BNB Chain Leads
items.summary: Tokenized-stock adoption reached 4.3 million holders, with BNB Chain leading the sector. A big RWA milestone for the $BNB ecosystem.

items.headline: Kalshi Wins Partial Illinois Ruling on Sports Contracts
items.summary: A judge found Illinois licensing rules likely conflict with federal derivatives law in Kalshi and Coinbase's favor, though transaction fees remain unresolved.

items.headline: Korean Super-App Toss Picks $OP Stack for Won Pilot
items.summary: Toss will run a won stablecoin pilot on the OP Stack, becoming the fourth regulated financial institution in a year to adopt $OP technology.
